Only one concrete implementation exists: the unexported struct `markdown.service`, created by `markdown.NewService`.

The interface is held by `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` and `RSSService.MarkdownService`. `memopayload.Runner` also holds it, but it is not started in production; `RebuildMemoPayload` uses the service from `APIV1Service` instead. The `APIV1Service` constructor in `v1.go` builds the concrete implementation via `markdown.NewService` with tag and mention extensions. Tests construct their own instances.

One concrete implementation exists. Production construction occurs in NewAPIV1Service via markdown.NewService. APIV1Service and RSSService hold the interface. memopayload.Runner type-holds the instance, though production passes it to RebuildMemoPayload.

h13.
markdown.service — NewAPIV1Service via markdown.NewService (server/router/api/v1/v1.go); holders: APIV1Service, RSSService, memopayload.Runner

The interface is `markdown.Service` in `internal/markdown/markdown.go`. The only implementation is the unexported `service` returned by `NewService`. Production builds it in `NewAPIV1Service` with `WithTagExtension` and `WithMentionExtension`. That instance is stored on `APIV1Service.MarkdownService`, passed into `RSSService` from `server/server.go`, and accepted by `memopayload.Runner` / `RebuildMemoPayload` (the API uses the same field). There is no second runtime impl.
